findings.evidence: "Leaving this field at its default is the right choice for most teams, and raising it is worth doing only when a specific integration needs the extra room."
findings.fix: Add the explicit default value (e.g., "defaults to 5000 ms") to the timeout section, matching how retries and logging each state their default.
findings.violation: The section refers to "its default" twice but never states what the actual default value is, so a reader has no way to know what timeout applies when the field is omitted.

findings.evidence: "The timeout field takes a duration in milliseconds, and the validator rejects any value below 1000."
findings.fix: Document the maximum allowed value, or explicitly state that there is no upper bound.
findings.violation: Only a lower bound is documented; unlike retries (which gives both a minimum and maximum of 0 to 10), there is no stated upper bound or maximum allowed timeout.

findings.evidence: "The retries field takes an integer from 0 to 10, and it defaults to 3."
findings.fix: Add a sentence describing the validator's behavior for out-of-range retries values.
findings.violation: Unlike the timeout section, which states what the validator does with out-of-range input ("the validator rejects any value below 1000"), this section never says what happens if a value outside 0 - 10 is submitted, making validation behavior inconsistent across fields.

findings.evidence: "- Metric catalog reference" (and the eight following bullet items)
findings.fix: Convert each bullet into a markdown link pointing to the real page path or URL.

findings.evidence: Only three fields are documented: timeout, retries, and logging.
findings.fix: Either add the missing fields or narrow the title/scope (e.g., "Alert rule delivery settings reference") to accurately reflect the limited content.
